description: Full KPI records: description, formula + candidate data sources (present for the 44 KPIs the site details in capability-page popups), official related capabilities, and where each is featured. Look up one KPI with `slug`, or filter by capability and/or featured_only — filters combine (AND), so a `slug` that doesn't match the `capability` filter returns zero records. Without filters, pages through the whole 88-entry library.

capability.description: Only KPIs featured on or officially related to this capability

featured_only.description: With `capability`: only KPIs featured on that capability's own page; alone: only KPIs featured on some page

slug.description: Exact KPI slug for a single-record lookup, e.g. 'allocation-accuracy-index-aai'

name: get_kpis
title: Get KPIs (full records)
